The appellant/accused who is convicted of the offences punishable under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code (for short 'I.P.C.') as well as under Sections 04 and 08 of the POCSO Act and who is sentenced to suffer imprisonment for life apart from imposition of some fine, he is seeking his release on bail during pendency of the appeal.
(2.) Heard the learned counsel appearing for the appellant/convicted accused.
He argued that there is no evidence of commission of penetrative sexual assault of rape by the appellant/convicted accused on victim of the crime in question.
It is argued that even evidence of the victim female child is accepted as it is then, also the case cannot travel beyond the Patna High Court CR.

APP (DB)
No.882 of 2022(4) dt.19-05-2023 offence of sexual assault
. And if that is so then, the appellant/convicted accused has undergone enough sentence as he is behind bar from 28.06.2019.
(3.) The learned APP opposed the prayer for grant of bail by contending that the crime in question is serious and is held to be proved by the learned Trial court.

sentences.text: (4.) We considered the submission so advanced.
Offence of penetrative sexual assault can be held to be proved if there is slightest penetration.
However, the victim female child, who is examined as PW-5 in her cross-examination has clarified as to how the incident took place.
She has stated that she has gone for easing herself.
Some other persons were also sitting besides her for easing.
Then, as per version of the victim female child the accused came from behind and caught her.
She is started shouting and then the appellant/convicted accused ran away.
The PW-3, Daya Devi claimed that she has rush to the spot of the incident and saw the accused running away from the spot of the incident.
Her cross-examination is to the effect that the victim female child was desirous of marrying the appellant/convicted accused.
It is defence of the appellant/accused reflected from cross-examination of prosecution witnesses that he and the victim female child were Patna High Court CR.
APP (DB) No.882 of 2022(4) dt.19-05-2023 in love

. Such suggestions are made to PW-4:-
the mother of the victim female child for suggesting her that her daughter was always talking with the appellant/convicted accused for hours together.

(5.) We have noted that the prosecution relied on photocopy of the school certificate of the victim female child but, prima facie, it seems that the same certificate was not proved the following necessary procedure.
Radiological age of the victim female child deposed by PW-6 Dr. Sushma Verma is 19 years.

(6.) In the wake of this infirm and laconic evidence which at the most indicate commission of sexual assault on the victim female child and the fact that evidence recording her age is also shrouded in mistzy, the appellant/convicted accused is entitled to be released on bail.
He has already undergone sufficient sentence from 28.06.2019 and the appeal filed by him is not likely to be heard in near future, considering the pendency of appeal before this Court.
(7.) Therefore, the following orders:-
(i) The appeal is allowed.
(ii)The substantive sentence of imprisonment imposed on the appellant/convicted accused till the disposal of the instant Patna High Court CR.

APP (DB) No.882 of 2022(4) dt.19-05-2023 appeal is suspended and the appellant/applicant is directed to be released on bail on executing P.R. bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand)
and on furnishing two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Exclusive Special Judge-cum-Additional District and Sessions Judge-VII, Gaya in POCSO Case No. 62 of 2019 arising out of Amas P.S. Case No. 133 of 2019.
(8.) As condition of this order:-
(i) The appellant should not contact the victim female child as well as her relative in any manner.
(ii) The appellant/applicant should co-operate in this Court till disposal of the appeal.
Till disposal of the appeal, recovery of fine is kept in abeyance.
